narrative.northStar: Did the promise reach the invoice?
narrative.overview: Current local correspondence candidate after explicit rejection of commit 081444c. A company story connects promise, exact source text, invoice result and next decision. One green mat, manila navigation and paper file frame covers every route, dialogs, examples and Office. This records source and inspected captures, not user approval, completed runtime acceptance, a deployment or native Figma parity.
keyCharacteristics: Cases, Documents, Companies and Reports as four primary file tabs.
Plain stories before technical references or overlapping KPI totals.
Archivo headings, Helvetica Neue reading, Martian metadata and red ink.
Original paper summary artwork is distinct from original supplied source text.
Same company mark/name moves into the case reader and back with reversible FLIP/WAAPI motion.
Office is an original illustration inside the shared file frame.

rules.name: One material environment
rules.body: All destinations, examples and dialogs share the mat/file/paper system; retain task-specific composition.

rules.name: Explain the actual financial result
rules.body: Original face amounts, matched portions, issued notes, invoice deductions, reversals and conditional spending retain separate meanings.

rules.name: Readable work
rules.body: Archivo heads, Helvetica Neue reading and Martian metadata; local font notices remain under public/fonts.

rules.name: Keep object and source identity
rules.body: Preserve the same selected company, exact source revision and draft; unavailable targets cannot become substitutes.

dos: Lead with company, promise, invoice result and next decision.
Retain exact source text, financial detail, policy and raw records in useful disclosures.
Operate normal-motion entry, interruption/reversal, keyboard return and reduced motion.
Reinspect wide/intermediate/phone repairs and distinguish current evidence from historical checks.
donts: Do not restore the rejected blue-gray dashboard or treat Formroom candidates as approved templates.
Do not label generated summary art as an original vendor invoice.
Do not confuse recording a domain action with composing or sending email.
Do not infer user approval, public deployment, native Figma parity or connected external services from tests.
